name: Jair
bio: Jair was a descendant of Manasseh. When Israel divided the land east of the Jordan, Jair went and captured several small towns in Gilead and named them Havvoth Jair, meaning "the villages of Jair" (Numbers 32:41). The name stuck for generations and is mentioned repeatedly in later Scripture to refer to that region (Deuteronomy 3:14; Joshua 13:30; Judges 10:4).
